description: Solve the open model as the Run button does, where the model's solver setting says (local on this computer, free; or the Convexity cloud, paid): use it without asking unless the user names one. A cloud run needs the user's go-ahead, then pass confirm_cloud. Every run is recorded; its results become the current results of the scenarios it solved. Do not edit the model while it runs.

confirm_cloud.description: Required true for a cloud run: the user agreed to pay.

representative_days.description: Capacity expansion on representative days (time-series aggregation) for this run: decide what to build on a few representative days of each year, then dispatch every hour with that fleet. Pass {} for the defaults.

foresight.description: myopic (default): year by year; perfect: all years at once.

scenario_ids.description: Scenarios to solve, by id or name; "base" or null for the base network. Omit for the open scenario.

wait.description: Block until the run ends and its results are in.

name: run_model
